summary: Global-E Online Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing a board-authorized share repurchase program of up to $500 million. The company has completed ~80% of its prior $200 million plan. Repurchases may occur via open market, privately negotiated transactions, or Rule 10b5-1 plans, subject to a 30-day creditor objection period under Israeli law. There is no stated price per share or premium. The program reflects management's confidence in cash flow generation and capital allocation strategy. No advisor or recommendation is noted. Investors should monitor the creditor objection window and actual repurchase execution pace for risk-arb implications.
